AcceptedMethod.description: AcceptedMethod defines a method for evaluation or enforcement.

AcceptedRisk.description:
AcceptedRisk documents a risk the organization has chosen to accept,
optionally linking it to a mitigated risk when the acceptance covers
residual risk after partial mitigation.

id.description: id allows this accepted risk entry to be referenced

justification.description: justification explains why the risk is accepted

risk.description: risk references the risk being accepted

scope.description: scope defines where the risk acceptance applies

target-id.description: target-id optionally links this acceptance to a mitigated risk entry

ActionResult.description: ActionResult captures a performed enforcement action.

disposition.description: disposition is the enforcement action taken

end.description: end is the timestamp when the enforcement action concluded

justification.description: justification links the action to its assessment findings and any applicable exceptions

message.description: message provides additional context about the action

method.description: method references the specific AcceptedMethod entry within the Policy being enforced

start.description: start is the timestamp when the enforcement action began

steps.description: steps references the code paths or addresses that carried out this enforcement action

Actor.description: Actor represents an entity (human or tool) that performs actions in evaluations

contact.description: contact is contact information for the actor

Adherence.description: Adherence defines evaluation methods, assessment plans, enforcement methods, and non-compliance notifications.

ArtifactMapping.description: ArtifactMapping represents a mapping to an external artifact or artifact entry

reference-id.description: reference-id identifies an element from a MappingReference in the artifact's metadata

remarks.description: remarks is prose regarding the mapped artifact or the mapping relationship

ArtifactType.description: ArtifactType identifies the kind of Gemara artifact for unambiguous parsing

AssessmentFinding.description: AssessmentFinding maps an enforcement action to its originating assessment data across Layer 2, Layer 3, and Layer 5.

log.description: log maps to the EvaluationLog entry containing the finding

plan.description: plan maps to the Policy assessment plan that was executed

requirement.description: requirement maps to the Layer 2 assessment requirement that was evaluated

result.description: result is the assessment outcome that triggered the enforcement action

AssessmentLog.description: AssessmentLog contains the results of executing a single assessment procedure for a control requirement.

applicability.description: Applicability is elevated from the Layer 2 Assessment Requirement to aid in execution and reporting.

confidence-level.description: ConfidenceLevel indicates the evaluator's confidence level in this specific assessment result.

description.description: Description provides a summary of the assessment procedure.

end.description: End is the timestamp when the assessment concluded.

evidence.description: Evidence records the raw data cited to support this assessment's opinion.

message.description: Message provides additional context about the assessment result.

plan.description: Plan maps to the policy assessment plan being executed.

recommendation.description: Recommendation provides guidance on how to address a failed assessment.

requirement.description: Requirement should map to the assessment requirement for this assessment.

result.description: Result is the overall outcome of the assessment procedure, matching the result of the last step that was run.

start.description:
Start is the timestamp when the assessment began.
Assessments that never executed have no start time to record.

steps.description: Steps are sequential actions taken as part of the assessment, which may halt the assessment if a failure occurs.

steps-executed.description: Steps-executed is the number of steps that were executed as part of the assessment.

AssessmentPlan.description: AssessmentPlan defines how a specific assessment requirement is evaluated.

AssessmentRequirement.description: AssessmentRequirement describes a tightly scoped, verifiable condition that must be satisfied and confirmed by an evaluator

applicability.description: applicability is a list of strings describing the situations where this text functions as a requirement for its parent control

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

recommendation.description: recommendation provides readers with non-binding suggestions to aid in evaluation or enforcement of the requirement

replaced-by.description: replaced-by references the assessment requirement that supersedes this one when deprecated or retired

state.description: state is the lifecycle state of this assessment requirement

text.description: text is the body of the requirement, typically written as a MUST condition

AssessmentRequirementModifier.description: AssessmentRequirementModifier allows organizations to customize assessment requirements based on how an organization wants to gather evidence for the objective.

applicability.description: The updated applicability of the assessment requirement

recommendation.description: The updated recommendation for the assessment requirement

text.description: The updated text of the assessment requirement

AuditLog.description: AuditLog records results from an audit performed against a target resource

criteria.description: criteria defines the acceptable state for the audited resource

owner.description: owner defines the RACI roles responsible for managing the audit

results.description: results records audit results against the criteria

AuditResult.description: AuditResult records a single result with supporting evidence and recommendations.

criteria-reference.description: criteria-reference maps this result to specific criteria entries

description.description: description explains the result in detail

evidence.description: evidence records the data sources that support this result

id.description: id uniquely identifies this result

recommendations.description: recommendations records corrective actions for this result

title.description: title describes this result at a glance

type.description: type classifies the nature of this result

Capability.description: Capability describes a system capability such as a feature, component or object.

description.description: description provides a detailed overview of this capability

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this capability belongs to

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

title.description: title describes this capability at a glance

CapabilityCatalog.description: CapabilityCatalog describes a collection of system capabilities

capabilities.description: capabilities is a list of capabilities defined by this catalog

Catalog.description: Catalog describes a set of topically-associated entries

extends.description: extends references catalogs that this catalog builds upon

groups.description: groups contains a list of groups that can be referenced by entries in this catalog

metadata.description: metadata provides detailed data about this catalog

title.description: title describes the purpose of this catalog at a glance

CatalogImport.description: CatalogImport defines how to import control catalogs with optional exclusions, constraints, and assessment requirement modifications.

ConfidenceLevel.description: ConfidenceLevel indicates the evaluator's confidence level in an assessment result.

Constraint.description: Constraint defines a prescriptive requirement that applies to a specific guidance or control.

id.description: Unique ID for this constraint to enable Layer 5/6 tracking

target-id.description: Links to the specific Guidance or Control being constrained

Contact.description: Contact is the contact information for a person or group

affiliation.description: affiliation is the organization with which the contact entity is associated, such as a team, school, or employer

email.description: email is the preferred email address to reach the contact

name.description: name is the preferred descriptor for the contact entity

social.description: social is a social media handle or other profile for the contact, such as GitHub

Control.description: Control describes a safeguard or countermeasure with a clear objective and assessment requirements

assessment-requirements.description: assessment-requirements is a list of requirements that must be verified to confirm the control objective has been met

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this control belongs to

guidelines.description: guidelines documents relationships between this control and Layer 1 guideline artifacts

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

objective.description: objective is a unified statement of intent, which may encompass multiple situationally applicable requirements

replaced-by.description: replaced-by references the control that supersedes this one when deprecated or retired

state.description: state is the lifecycle state of this control

threats.description: threats documents relationships between this control and Layer 2 threat artifacts

title.description: title describes the purpose of this control at a glance

ControlCatalog.description: ControlCatalog describes a set of related controls and relevant metadata

controls.description: controls is a list of unique controls defined by this catalog

ControlEvaluation.description: ControlEvaluation contains the results of evaluating a single Layer 5 control.

allOf.description:
Enforce that control reference and the assessments' references match
This formulation uses the control's reference if the assessment doesn't include a reference
Require start timestamp on assessments that actually executed

assessment-logs.description:
Enforce that control reference and the assessments' references match
This formulation uses the control's reference if the assessment doesn't include a reference

Require start timestamp on assessments that actually executed

Datetime.description: Datetime represents an ISO 8601 formatted datetime string

Dimensions.description: Dimensions specify the applicability criteria for a policy

geopolitical.description: geopolitical is an optional list of geopolitical regions

sensitivity.description: sensitivity is an optional list of data classification levels

technologies.description: technologies is an optional list of technology categories or services

users.description: users is an optional list of user roles

Disposition.description: Disposition enumerates the possible enforcement outcomes.

Email.description: Email represents a validated email address pattern

EnforcementLog.description: EnforcementLog records actions taken in response to noncompliance findings from Layer 5 evaluations.

allOf.description: Enforce that Clear dispositions only contain Passed assessment results
actions is the list of enforcement actions performed

actions.description:
actions is the list of enforcement actions performed

Enforce that Clear dispositions only contain Passed assessment results

disposition.description: disposition is the aggregate enforcement disposition across all actions in this log

EnforcementStep.description: EnforcementStep is a reference to the code that performed an enforcement action

Entity.description: Entity represents a human or tool

description.description: description provides additional context about the entity

id.description: id uniquely identifies the entity and allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

name.description: name is the name of the entity

type.description: type specifies the type of entity interacting in the workflow

uri.description: uri is a general URI for the entity information

version.description: version is the version of the entity (for tools; if applicable)

EntityType.description: EntityType specifies what entity is interacting in the workflow

EntryMapping.description: EntryMapping represents how a specific entry maps to a MappingReference.

entry-id.description: entry-id is the identifier being mapped to in the referenced artifact

reference-id.description: reference-id is the id for a MappingReference entry in the artifact's metadata

remarks.description: remarks is prose describing the mapping relationship

EntryType.description: EntryType enumerates the atomic units within Gemara artifacts that can participate in mappings

EvaluationLog.description: EvaluationLog contains the results of evaluating a set of Layer 2 controls.

result.description: result is the aggregate outcome across all evaluations in this log

Evidence.description:
Evidence records what was cited to support an opinion for a specific activity:
raw data for the evaluation layer, evaluation and enforcement artifacts for the audit layer.
At least one of payload or source MUST be present; an entry with neither is semantically incomplete.

collected-at.description: collected-at is the timestamp when the evidence was gathered

description.description: description explains what this evidence represents

id.description: id uniquely identifies this evidence

payload.description: payload is the raw evidence data collected inline

source.description: source identifies the artifact or system from which this evidence was collected

type.description: type categorizes the kind of evidence

EvidenceMapping.description:
EvidenceMapping identifies the source from which evidence was collected.
reference-id names the MappingReference; coordinate or entry-id gives
specificity within it; digest pins the observed content at collection time.

coordinate.description:
coordinate is the precise location within the stream identified by reference-id
(e.g. an API path, file path, or JSON path expression).
Do not set if entry-id is set.

digest.description: digest is a cryptographic hash of the observed content at collection time; format: algorithm:encoded (e.g. sha256:abc123...)

entry-id.description:
entry-id identifies a specific entry within a referenced Gemara artifact.
Do not set if coordinate is set.

reference-id.description: reference-id ties this evidence to a mapping-reference in the artifact's metadata

remarks.description: remarks is prose regarding this evidence reference

EvidenceType.description:
EvidenceType categorizes the kind of evidence. It remains an open enum:
recommended values include artifact types already known to Gemara (e.g.
EvaluationLog, EnforcementLog) plus categories for common evidence forms.

Exemption.description: Exemption describes a single scenario where the catalog is not applicable

description.description: description identifies who or what is exempt from the full guidance

reason.description: reason explains why the exemption is granted

redirect.description: redirect points to alternative guidelines or controls that should be followed instead

Group.description: Group represents a classification or grouping that can be used in different contexts with semantic meaning derived from its usage

description.description: description explains the significance and traits of entries to this group

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

title.description: title describes the purpose of this group at a glance

GuidanceCatalog.description: GuidanceCatalog represents a concerted documentation effort to help bring about an optimal future without foreknowledge of the implementation details

exemptions.description: exemptions provides information about situations where this guidance is not applicable

front-matter.description: front-matter provides introductory text for the document to be used during rendering

guidelines.description: guidelines is a list of unique guidelines defined by this catalog

type.description: type categorizes this document based on the intent of its contents

GuidanceImport.description: GuidanceImport defines how to import guidance documents with optional exclusions and constraints.

constraints.description: Constraints allow policy authors to define ad hoc minimum requirements (e.g., "review at least annually").

GuidanceType.description: GuidanceType restricts the possible types that a catalog may be listed as

Guideline.description: Guideline provides explanatory context and recommendations for designing optimal outcomes

applicability.description: applicability specifies the contexts in which this guideline applies

extends.description: extends is an id for a guideline which this guideline adds to, in this document or elsewhere

group.description: group provides an id to the group that this guideline belongs to

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

objective.description: objective is a unified statement of intent, which may encompass multiple situationally applicable statements

principles.description: principles documents the relationship between this guideline and one or more principles

rationale.description: rationale provides the context for this guideline

recommendations.description: recommendations is a list of non-binding suggestions to aid in evaluation or enforcement of the guideline

replaced-by.description: replaced-by references the guideline that supersedes this one when deprecated or retired

see-also.description: see-also lists related guideline IDs within the same GuidanceCatalog

state.description: state is the lifecycle state of this guideline

statements.description: statements is a list of structural sub-requirements within a guideline

title.description: title describes the contents of this guideline

vectors.description: vector-mappings documents the relationship between this guideline and one or more vectors

ImplementationDetails.description: ImplementationDetails specifies the timeline for policy implementation.

ImplementationPlan.description: ImplementationPlan defines when and how the policy becomes active.

Imports.description: Imports defines external policies, controls, and guidelines required by this policy.

Justification.description: Justification provides the assessment data and exception references that justify an enforcement action.

assessments.description: assessments links the action to one or more Assessment Findings

exceptions.description: exceptions references approved Policy exceptions that authorize the action

Lexicon.description: Lexicon is a controlled vocabulary or glossary artifact referenced by Metadata.lexicon

metadata.description: metadata provides detailed data about this document

terms.description: terms is one or more defined entries for linking and rendering

title.description: title describes the purpose of this lexicon at a glance

LexiconReference.description: LexiconReference cites a source supporting a lexicon definition

citation.description: citation identifies the source material in prose

url.description: url points to supporting material when available

LexiconTerm.description: LexiconTerm is a single definition within a lexicon

definition.description: definition explains the meaning of the term

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced for anchors and tooling

references.description: references cites external authorities supporting the definition

synonyms.description: synonyms lists alternative labels that should resolve to this term for linking

title.description: title is the canonical name of the defined concept

Lifecycle.description: Lifecycle represents the lifecycle state of a guideline, control, or assessment requirement

Log.description: Log describes a set of recorded entries from a measurement activity

metadata.description: metadata provides detailed data about this log

target.description: target identifies the resource being evaluated

Mapping.description: Mapping represents a relationship between a source entry and one or more target entries

id.description: id allows this mapping to be referenced by other elements

relationship.description: relationship describes the nature of the mapping between source and all targets

remarks.description: remarks is general prose regarding this mapping

source.description: source identifies the entry being mapped from by its entry-id

targets.description: targets identifies the entries being mapped to; absent when relationship is no-match

MappingDocument.description: MappingDocument captures the user's intent for how entries in a source artifact relate to entries in a target artifact

mappings.description: mappings is one or more atomic relationships between entries in the referenced artifacts

metadata.description: metadata provides detailed data about this document

remarks.description: remarks is prose regarding this mapping document

source-reference.description: source-reference identifies the artifact being mapped from; must match a mapping-reference id

target-reference.description: target-reference identifies the artifact being mapped to; must match a mapping-reference id

title.description: title describes the purpose of this mapping document at a glance

MappingReference.description: MappingReference represents a reference to an external document with full metadata.

description.description: description is prose regarding the artifact's purpose or content

id.description:
id identifies this mapping reference within the artifact and, when url
is absent, the referenced artifact's metadata.id.

title.description: title describes the purpose of this mapping reference at a glance

url.description: url is the path where the artifact may be retrieved; preferably responds with Gemara-compatible YAML/JSON

version.description: version is the version identifier of the artifact being mapped to

MappingTarget.description: MappingTarget identifies a target entry with optional per-target metadata

applicability.description: applicability constrains the contexts in which this target mapping holds

entry-id.description: entry-id identifies the specific entry in the target artifact

rationale.description: rationale explains why this relationship exists for this target

remarks.description: remarks is general prose regarding this target mapping

strength.description: strength is the author's estimate of how completely the source satisfies this target; range 1-10

Metadata.description: Metadata represents common metadata fields shared across all layers

applicability-groups.description: applicability-groups is a list of groups used to classify within this artifact to specify scope

author.description: author is the person or group primarily responsible for this artifact

date.description: date is the publication or effective date of this artifact

description.description: description provides a high-level summary of the artifact's purpose and scope

draft.description: draft indicates whether this artifact is a pre-release version; open to modification

gemara-version.description: gemara-version declares which version of the Gemara specification this artifact conforms to

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

lexicon.description: lexicon is a URI pointing to a controlled vocabulary or glossary relevant to this artifact

mapping-references.description: mapping-references is a list of external documents referenced within this artifact

type.description: type identifies the kind of Gemara artifact for unambiguous parsing

version.description: version is the version identifier of this artifact

MitigatedRisk.description: MitigatedRisk represents a risk addressed by the policy

id.description: id allows this mitigated risk entry to be referenced by accepted risks

risk.description: risk references the risk being mitigated

ModType.description: ModType defines the type of modification to the assessment requirement.

MultiEntryMapping.description: MultiEntryMapping represents a mapping to an external reference with one or more entries.

entries.description: entries is a list of mapping entries

Parameter.description: Parameter defines a configurable parameter for assessment or enforcement activities.

Policy.description: Policy represents a policy document with metadata, contacts, scope, imports, implementation plan, risks, and adherence requirements.

Principle.description: Principle represents a foundational value or tenet that guides governance, design, and operational decisions

description.description: description explains the principle and its expected outcomes

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this principle belongs to

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

rationale.description: rationale provides the context for this principle

title.description: title describes the principle at a glance

PrincipleCatalog.description: PrincipleCatalog describes a set of related principles and relevant metadata

principles.description: principles is a list of unique principles defined by this catalog

RACI.description: RACI defines the roles responsible for managing an artifact

accountable.description: accountable identifies the entity ultimately accountable for the outcome

consulted.description: consulted identifies entities whose input is required when assessing or responding to the artifact

informed.description: informed identifies entities that should be notified about changes to the artifact status

responsible.description: responsible identifies the entities responsible for executing work to manage or mitigate the artifact

Rationale.description: Rationale provides a structured way to communicate a guideline author's intent

goals.description: goals is a list of outcomes this guideline seeks to achieve

importance.description: importance is an explanation of why this guideline matters

Recommendation.description: Recommendation provides a corrective action for an audit result

id.description: id uniquely identifies this recommendation

required.description: required indicates whether this recommendation is a mandatory corrective action

text.description: text describes the recommended corrective action

RelationshipType.description: RelationshipType enumerates the nature of the mapping between entries.

Resource.description: Resource represents an entity that exists in the system and can be evaluated

environment.description: environment describes where the resource exists (e.g., production, staging, development, specific region)

owner.description: owner is the contact information for the person or group responsible for managing or owning this resource

ResultType.description: ResultType classifies the nature of an audit result

Risk.description: A Risk represents the potential for negative impact resulting from one or more threats.

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this risk belongs to

id.description: id allows this risk to be referenced by other elements

impact.description: impact describes the business or operational impact

owner.description: owner defines the RACI roles responsible for managing this risk

rank.description:
rank optionally orders risks for the same catalog (e.g. when several share the same severity).
Lower values mean higher relative importance. Omitted when the four severity levels are enough.
When set, each value must be unique among all risks in the catalog that specify rank.

severity.description: severity describes the assessed level of this risk

threats.description: threats link this risk to Layer 2 threats

RiskAppetite.description: RiskAppetite defines the acceptable level of exposure for a risk category

RiskCatalog.description:
A RiskCatalog is a structured collection of documented risks that may affect an organization,
system, or service. It provides a centralized reference for risks that can be mapped to threats
and referenced by policies when documenting how those risks are mitigated or accepted.

groups.description: groups narrows the base groups to risk categories with appetite and severity boundaries

risks.description: risks is a list of risks defined by this catalog

RiskCategory.description: RiskCategory describes a grouping of risks and defines appetite boundaries

appetite.description: appetite defines the acceptable level of risk for this category

max-severity.description:
max-severity defines the risk tolerance boundary: the highest severity
the organization will accept within this category

Risks.description: Risks defines mitigated and accepted risks addressed by this policy.

accepted.description: Accepted risks require rationale (justification) and may include scope. Controls addressing these risks are implicitly identified through threat mappings.

mitigated.description: Mitigated risks only need reference-id and risk-id (no justification required)

Scope.description: Scope defines what is included and excluded from policy applicability.

Severity.description: Severity defines the assessed level of a risk based on its potential impact and likelihood

Statement.description:
Statement represents a structural sub-requirement within a guideline;
They do not increase strictness and all statements within a guideline apply together

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

recommendations.description: recommendations is a list of non-binding suggestions to aid in evaluation or enforcement of the statement

text.description: text is the body of this statement

title.description: title describes the contents of this statement

Threat.description: Threat describes a specifically-scoped opportunity for a negative impact to the organization

actors.description: actors describes the relevant internal or external threat actors

capabilities.description: capabilities documents the relationship between this threat and a system capability

description.description: description provides a detailed explanation of an opportunity for negative impact

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this threat belongs to

id.description: id allows this entry to be referenced by other elements

title.description: title describes this threat at a glance

vectors.description: vectors documents the relationship between this threat and one or more vectors

ThreatCatalog.description: ThreatCatalog describes a set of topically-associated threats

threats.description: threats is a list of threats defined by this catalog

TypedMapping.description: TypedMapping extends ArtifactMapping with a required entry-type for all entries in this direction

entry-type.description: entry-type identifies the type of atomic unit entries in this direction

Vector.description: A Vector represents a method, pathway, or technique through which a threat may be realized or an attack may be carried out.

applicability.description: applicability specifies the contexts in which this vector can manifest

description.description: description explains how the attack vector works

group.description: group references by id a catalog group that this vector belongs to

id.description: id allows this vector to be referenced by other elements

vectors.description: vectors is a list of attack vectors documented in this catalog

_AssessmentLogStrict.description: _AssessmentLogStrict layers the "start required unless unexecuted" rule on top of #AssessmentLog

_MappingStrict.description: _MappingStrict layers the "targets required when not no-match" rule on top of #Mapping

reference-id.description: reference-id is the id for a MappingReference entry in the artifact's metadata
